positive_global_styles: instrumental cinematic documentary score for a premium YouTube guide about the novels of Stephen King
key of D minor, around 96 BPM unless stated otherwise
felt piano, music box, warm cello and string pads, soft analog synth pulses, tight modern percussion, subtle sub bass
elegant, intriguing and atmospheric with warmth, never cheesy horror
mix leaves plenty of space for a spoken voice-over in the mid range

positive_local_styles: cold open: an eerie music box melody over a low warm drone from the very first second
a soft heartbeat-like kick pulse enters after a few seconds
tension slowly builds with ticking clock-like percussion
opens up into warmer strings in the last four seconds
keeps playing at full energy until the very last second, no ending
